description: This is a Kotlin test source file that contains UI test cases for the Interests List and Detail Screen in an Android Jetpack Compose application. It uses Hilt for dependency injection, Jetpack Compose testing libraries, and Robolectric for running tests on the JVM. The tests verify the UI behavior under different screen width configurations and user interactions.

classes.name: InterestsListDetailScreenTest
classes.description: Test class for UI behaviors of Interests List and Detail screens, including layout assertions and navigation responses.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes dependency injection before each test.

methods.name: expandedWidth_initialState_showsTwoPanesWithPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that on an expanded screen, the two-pane layout shows the list with a placeholder when no topic is selected.

methods.name: compactWidth_initialState_showsListPane
methods.description: Verifies that on a compact screen, only the list pane is visible initially.

methods.name: expandedWidth_topicSelected_updatesDetailPane
methods.description: Checks that selecting a topic updates the detail pane in an expanded layout.

methods.name: compactWidth_topicSelected_showsTopicDetailPane
methods.description: Checks that selecting a topic in a compact layout displays the topic details pane.

methods.name: compactWidth_backPressFromTopicDetail_showsListPane
methods.description: Ensures that pressing back in a compact layout returns to the list pane.
